text: The Nominating Panel - Corporations must select candidates to interview for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board. Following the interviews, the Nominating - Corporations Panel will recommend candidates for appointment to City Council.

The Nominating Panel - Corporations: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting on May 17, 2023 for appointments to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors: TCH2-301 TCH2-319 TCH2-310 TCH2-303 TCH2-278 TCH2-249 TCH2-317 TCH2-256 TCH2-275 TCH2-323 TCH2-324 TCH2-274 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (April 10, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Community Housing Corporation Board of Directors.
